links.outcome: Likert accuracy, clarity, relevance of GPT-4 with RAG versus other LLMs on ALF queries
links.effect: GPT-4 with RAG scored highest across accuracy, clarity, relevance (4.70, 4.89, 4.78) versus GPT-4 without RAG (3.67 accuracy, 4.04 clarity, 4.01 relevance).
links.quote: ChatGPT 4, augmented with RAG, demonstrated superior performance compared with others, consistently scoring the highest (4.70, 4.89, 4.78) across all 3 domains.

links.outcome: Comparison of five LLMs and RAG-enhanced GPT-4 on the same ALF questions
links.effect: GPT-4+RAG scored highest (4.70, 4.89, 4.78); BARD scored 2.01 accuracy and COPILOT 2.26 accuracy, showing large differences between candidate tools.
links.quote: Meanwhile, BARD and COPILOT exhibited lower performance levels; BARD recorded scores of 2.01 in accuracy and 3.03 in relevance, while COPILOT obtained 2.26 in accuracy and 3.12 in relevance.
